silo_summary.overall_note: The RM analytical layer is anchored in real recurring memo signals around loading costs, noise sensitivity, governance, and tail-risk estimation, so the themes are not arbitrary. However, several themes overextend from those signals into stronger field-level claims about hybridization, selection bias, maturity paradoxes, or narrow QML niches that the sampled memos do not directly establish.
